messages:
matt: Quick intake ask — I pulled a promising new candidate: zodiac-7b (HF: zonation/zodiac-7b). Good LMBench and GLUE numbers. Thinking we should prioritize a basic bring-up + 4-bit quant experiment. any objections?

nora: +1 to experiments. What are our primary failure modes to watch (summaries/regression tests)?

matt: Good Q. From the repo notes: stronger on code and long-context QA, slight regressions on abstractive summarization vs our current default. Plan: 1) model manifest + catalog entry 2) run smoke evals (summarize/chat/classify) 3) quant runs (4-bit/8-bit) 4) compare against baseline on our eval-suite 5) docs + announcement.

li: I can own the catalog entry + docs. Quick ask — who will own the rollout/canary?

sara: I can coordinate announcement timing and marketing blurb once we have a sane perf/cost delta. Can we aim for an internal preview next Wed?

matt: @sara yes internal preview Wed works. @li can you have a first draft of the catalog metadata by Tue EOD?

li: Yep. I'll create a draft under docs/models/zodiac-7b.md and link the manifest.

nora: For evals I'll kick off the smoke suite against master baseline + zodiac-7b. Expected runtime ~45m per suite. Focused tests: summarization (CNN/DailyMail subset), code generation (HumanEval subset), long-context QA (our 16k sim).

matt: Quant command I used locally (for reference):
```bash
python quantize.py --model ./zodiac-7b --out ./zodiac-7b-4bit --bits 4 --group-size 128 --seed 42
```
Expect a ~2.5x speedup on T4 inference for short responses, KV cache perf TBD.

nora: Heads-up: on a quick run, 4-bit FP4-style produced a small ROUGE drop (~2.8 pts) on our summarization slice vs fp16. Need to evaluate whether that's visible in user-facing prompts. I'll upload eval diffs to the eval dashboard.

matt: Noted. Let's gate announcement on: (a) latency within 1.2x of baseline on common routes, (b) quality regression <= 1.5 ROUGE pts on our core summaries OR acceptable fallback route, (c) cost-per-token improvement > 35% for typical request mix.

li: Draft metadata I'll include: model_name, repo, default_revision, quant_profiles (4bit-fast, 8bit-safe), recommended_routes, example_prompts, security_notes. Anything else?

sara: Add a short "suitable_for" field (chat, code-assist, summarization-caveats). We'll use that in product docs.

ops-bot: Reminder: File a Dedicated capacity request if you plan to run large-scale quant experiments on staging GPUs. See https://internal.redwood/infra/requests

matt: Good call. I'll submit a request for 4 x A100 for a 48h window.

ci-bot: CI | zodiac-7b-smoke-run finished — status: SUCCESS — artifacts: http://ci.internal/reports/1954321987-smoke

nora: Uploaded first eval artifacts. Quick summary: code gen + long-context are equal-or-better. Summarization shows the ROUGE hit I mentioned. Detailed diffs in CI artifact + eval dashboard.

matt: OK next steps: Nora to run full eval battery and produce a short triage doc by Tue morning. Li to put up catalog draft Tue EOD. Sara to draft announcement copy (internal preview Wed). I'll run extended 4-bit perf runs and submit capacity request. If regression is confirmed >1.5 ROUGE pts we'll explore 8-bit profile or model-variant fallback.

li: I'll tag docs PR with owners and add the sample prompt set.

sara: Sounds good. @matt please ping when the perf numbers land so I can slot marketing. :rocket:

matt: Will do. Thanks all — keeping this thread for updates.
